name: reasoning_marker_penalty_v1
law: OFF BY DEFAULT. An experimental sampler arm, never a default fire shape. Loaded only when a caller passes --penalty-profile (CLI) or penalty_profile= (LlamaCppBridge). Penalizing common hedge tokens can damage normal prose; measure before trusting.
mechanism: Training-free token-specific penalties at the sampler (decode-side logit bias), the banked 10-03 mechanism: on a reasoning model, W3 PTQ inflates CoT length 2.94x (GPTQ) to 3.77x (AWQ) while accuracy falls 60.13 to 33.82, and training-free token-specific penalties recover up to 9.8 accuracy points while cutting CoT length up to 51.3 percent. Source: watch/inbox/frontier_olm_2026-10-03/steal/quantization-and-compression.md:31 (RATIO, arXiv 2609.39801). Cheap leg of the staged port in watch/inbox/frontier_olm_2026-10-07/steal/finetuning-adaptation.md find 1 (weight-side RL penalty is the durable leg; this file is the no-training decode-side twin).
mining: Marker candidates mined 2026-10-07 by token census over the estate's EMPTY_REASONING receipt surfaces (the disease: the model spends the whole output budget on hidden reasoning and the content channel returns empty, mag/inference_budget.py:13, EMPTY_REASONING TERMINAL at mag/inference_budget.py:19). Surfaces: memory/runs/hermes_burn/*.jsonl + driver.log, memory/behavioral/animals/*.jsonl, watch/inbox/model_garden/FABLE1.md (the fable B1/B5 12000/12000 reasoning-cap burns), memory/rib/RIB_MODEL_GATES_20261001.md. Hedge-class candidates named by the finetuning card (wait/however/alternatively class inside thinking blocks) are carried even where the receipt census reads zero.
